items.title: Proof records are valid
items.acceptance: All module-proof records pass schema and semantic checks.

items.title: Core motor-control proofs exist
items.acceptance: ALG-01 to ALG-04 and ALG-17 are covered by traceable proof records.

items.title: Immediate power-electronics modules exist
items.acceptance: LLC deepening, three-level topology/SVPWM, Vienna, Boost PFC bus dynamics, and system design are in the proof chain.

items.title: Workflow schemas are valid
items.acceptance: Config, trace, and proof schemas are parseable and repository examples conform.

items.title: Knowledge-to-lxfoc export and trace import are executable
items.acceptance: The backend can generate json/h/c/manifest/README and analyze standard trace metrics.

items.title: Datasets are reproducible
items.acceptance: Archived trace reports can be recomputed and match stored reports.

items.title: Simulation-to-measurement comparison is archived
items.acceptance: At least one dataset includes simulation_trace.csv and a recomputable comparison_report.json.

items.title: At least one verified low-voltage PMSM hardware dataset exists
items.acceptance: A calibrated hardware trace is marked verified and passes dataset validation.

items.title: At least one proof can be promoted to verified
items.acceptance: A reviewed proof references verified hardware evidence with raw capture, calibration, report, and comparison artifacts.

items.title: lxfoc benchmark matrix is valid
items.acceptance: Each benchmark record references existing lxfoc modules and valid trace fields.

items.title: P0 algorithms are at least partially benchmarked
items.acceptance: Every P0 algorithm has covered or partial selftest/bench evidence.

items.title: Release report is generated
items.acceptance: Human-readable and machine-readable release reports are present.

items.title: Contribution and verification docs exist
items.acceptance: Long-term contribution, correctness review, hardware validation, pending user hardware-test marker, closed-loop workflow, and 30% roadmap docs are present.
